rules.statement: AHB HCLK and AXI ACLK, and all FIFO instances, must use the same physical i_clk_core input, rising-edge, with no internal clock gating.
The bridge must operate in the single CLK-CORE domain and must not contain asynchronous crossings, synchronizer chains, Gray pointers or CDC FIFOs.
Each m_vlsit_sfifo_top write/read clock input must be tied to i_clk_core and its two reset inputs tied to i_rst_n_core.
Reset values must be HREADYOUT=1, HRESP=OKAY, AWVALID/WVALID/ARVALID=0, BREADY/RREADY=0, and FIFO valid state cleared, for all bridge logic and five FIFOs.
The SoC must provide one active-low reset net i_rst_n_core to both protocol sides and all FIFOs, asserted asynchronously and with deassertion synchronized to i_clk_core before the IP.
The RTL must use i_rst_n_core directly and must not contain a reset synchronizer.
No transaction may be accepted by the bridge until reset is released.

rules.condition: When reset discards bridge-buffered commands/data and in-flight responses
rules.statement: The system must reset the connected AXI endpoint/interconnect consistently so a stale response cannot be mistaken for a new transaction.
